description: This Java class, DriverFactory, manages WebDriver lifecycle with thread-safe support for parallel test execution. It initializes WebDriver instances for Chrome and Firefox browsers based on configuration, sets timeouts, and handles driver cleanup.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: Utility class to manage WebDriver instances with thread safety, supporting Chrome and Firefox browsers with optional headless mode.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Returns the thread-local WebDriver instance, creating and configuring it if necessary.

methods.name: quitDriver
methods.description: Quits the thread-local WebDriver instance and removes it from thread storage.

methods.name: createDriver
methods.description: Creates a WebDriver based on configured browser type and headless setting.

methods.name: createChromeDriver
methods.description: Initializes a Chrome WebDriver with specific options including headless mode if specified.

methods.name: createFirefoxDriver
methods.description: Initializes a Firefox WebDriver with specific options including headless mode if specified.

methods.name: configureDriver
methods.description: Configures timeouts and maximizes the browser window for the WebDriver instance.
